"""Own temporary packaging checks; no network, DB, listener or OS limits."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tarfile
import zipfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
checkout = Path("C:/Users/w.filho/Desktop/codes/mask")
assert root.name.startswith("maskgw-domain-package-20261023-")
assert root.is_relative_to(Path(os.environ["LOCALAPPDATA"]) / "Temp")
assert not root.is_relative_to(checkout)
os.chdir(root)
env_names = {"PATH", "PATHEXT", "COMSPEC", "SYSTEMROOT", "WINDIR", "TEMP", "TMP",
             "APPDATA", "LOCALAPPDATA", "USERPROFILE", "SYSTEMDRIVE", "PROGRAMFILES",
             "PROGRAMFILES(X86)", "PROGRAMW6432", "HOMEDRIVE", "HOMEPATH", "OS"}
env = {key: value for key, value in os.environ.items() if key.upper() in env_names}
env.update(PIP_NO_INDEX="1", PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK="1",
           PIP_CONFIG_FILE=os.devnull, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1")
commands = []
def run(name, args, *, negative=False):
    with (root / (name + ".log")).open("xb") as log:
        result = subprocess.run(args, cwd=root, env=env, timeout=120,
                                stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=False)
    commands.append({"name": name, "exit": result.returncode})
    if (result.returncode == 0) == negative:
        raise RuntimeError("unexpected command result")
    return (root / (name + ".log")).read_text(encoding="utf8")
def names_ok(names):
    assert 1 <= len(names) <= 1024 and len(names) == len(set(names))
    for name in names:
        assert len(name) <= 512 and "\\" not in name and ":" not in name
        path = PurePosixPath(name)
        assert not path.is_absolute() and not {"..", ".codex", ".claude", "docs", "tests", "frontend"} & set(path.parts)
        assert not any(part.endswith(".stackdump") or part == "systeminfo" for part in path.parts)
        assert (root / "extracted" / str(path)).resolve().is_relative_to(root / "extracted")
wheel = next((root / "artifacts").glob("*.whl"))
sdist = next((root / "artifacts").glob("*.tar.gz"))
with zipfile.ZipFile(wheel) as archive:
    items = archive.infolist()
    names_ok([item.filename for item in items])
    assert sum(item.file_size for item in items) <= 16 * 1024 * 1024
    assert archive.read("maskgw/runtime/domain.py") == (checkout / "src/maskgw/runtime/domain.py").read_bytes()
    wheel_members = len(items)
extract = root / "extracted"
extract.mkdir()
with tarfile.open(sdist, "r:gz") as archive:
    items = archive.getmembers()
    names_ok([item.name for item in items])
    assert all(item.isdir() or item.isfile() for item in items)
    assert sum(item.size for item in items) <= 16 * 1024 * 1024
    assert all(item.name.split("/")[0] == "maskgw-0.1.0" for item in items)
    archive.extractall(extract, members=items)
    sdist_members = len(items)
probe = root / "domain_package_probe.py"
shutil.copyfile(checkout / "tests/domain_package_probe.py", probe)
sdist_wheels = root / "sdist-wheel"
run("build-sdist", [sys.executable, "-m", "build", "--no-isolation", "--wheel",
                   "--outdir", str(sdist_wheels), str(extract / "maskgw-0.1.0")])
rebuilt = next(sdist_wheels.glob("*.whl"))
reports = {}
for label, package in (("wheel", wheel), ("sdist", rebuilt)):
    target = root / ("target-" + label)
    target.mkdir()
    run("install-" + label, [sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "--no-index",
        "--no-deps", "--no-compile", "--target", str(target), str(package)])
    raw = run("probe-" + label, [sys.executable, "-I", "-B", str(probe), str(target), str(checkout)])
    report = json.loads(raw)
    assert report["source_match"] is True and report["maskgw_outside_checkout"] is True
    reports[label] = report
negative = root / "target-stale"
shutil.copytree(root / "target-wheel", negative)
with (negative / "maskgw/runtime/domain.py").open("a", encoding="utf8") as stream:
    stream.write("\n# deliberately stale package counterexample\n")
raw = run("reject-stale", [sys.executable, "-I", "-B", str(probe), str(negative),
                           str(checkout)], negative=True)
assert "installed module differs from reviewed source" in raw
raw = run("reject-checkout", [sys.executable, "-I", "-B", str(probe),
                              str(checkout / "src"), str(checkout)], negative=True)
assert "probe must run outside checkout" in raw
result = {
    "root": str(root), "python": sys.version.split()[0],
    "wheel_members": wheel_members, "sdist_members": sdist_members,
    "commands": commands, "reports": reports,
    "sha256": {label: hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
               for label, path in (("wheel", wheel), ("sdist", sdist), ("rebuilt", rebuilt))},
    "claim": "installed C1 module origins and source equality only",
}
(root / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf8")
print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))
